# Golden Horse Award for Best Cinematography

}}
The Golden Horse Award for Best Cinematography () is presented annually at Taiwan's Golden Horse Film Awards. From the 1st Golden Horse Awards in 1962 to the 14th edition in 1977, the category was titled Best Color Cinematography. During that period, a separate award for Best Black and White Cinematography was also presented five times.
